verdict.rationale: Epic publishes a generated per-class and per-function Unreal Python API reference that plain clients can fetch. It also publishes Remote Control HTTP/WebSocket API references with example JSON messages that can be sent to the engine's built-in web server. However, these references are static: nothing shows an in-browser interactive explorer or one-click runnable examples, and the Python API is marked Experimental. Missing for 10: interactive try-it console or sandbox in the reference, runnable code examples embedded in API pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference's usability.
